steps.summary: Nine font sizes and four weights became a five-step ladder with two weights, so headings are found by size and nothing on the page shouts.

changes.what: Page title is smaller and lighter, a label for where you are rather than a banner
Font weights in use
Distinct font sizes on the page
Uppercase, tracked group labels set in sentence case
The dialog title no longer outranks the section headings beside it
Field labels step down to a label size and tier so the values lead
Button text set as control text
Numbers set in tabular figures, and a metric-matched fallback so the font swap doesn't reflow
changes.before: proportional figures; no fallback metrics; 4 Inter weights downloaded
changes.after: tabular-nums on body; Arial fallback at size-adjust 107.12%; 2 weights downloaded

steps.summary: Every control edge and text tier now clears its contrast floor in both themes, and colour is spent only on what needs a person, not on what is merely connected or done.

changes.what: Input, search and switch-off edges are visible enough to read as controls
Primary button text in dark mode is readable
"Unsaved changes" is no longer low-contrast amber text: the words stay in ink and an amber dot carries the state
"Connected" badges drop the green: being connected needs nobody, so the dot's shape (filled vs ring) says it
changes.after: ink #4e535b on #f9fafb, 7.41:1; filled dot vs ring

changes.what: Field errors keep their sentence in ink; a red alert glyph carries the error
Met password rules show an ink tick on a neutral circle instead of a green disc
changes.law: color law 7 · done in a sequence passed through
changes.after: ink tick on a 3.37:1 neutral ring

changes.what: Greys lose their blue cast
changes.after: chroma 0.015; tertiary 4.89:1 on its worst surface (was 4.64:1)

changes.what: The avatar takes one flat person colour instead of the accent blue gradient

steps.summary: The page becomes a product shell — one sidebar for all navigation — with its sections stacked on the page instead of in five boxes.

changes.what: Navigation lives in one sidebar instead of a top bar plus a second settings sidebar
changes.law: layout dial: app shell, no top bar
changes.before: 2 navigation regions (60px top bar + 240px settings rail)
changes.after: 1 sidebar, 240px, with a 44px header bar over the page

changes.what: Sections sit on the page, opened by their heading, not boxed
changes.after: 0 boxes; sections parted by 40px of space

changes.what: Tinted footer strips behind the save buttons are gone
changes.before: 4 grey #f9fafb strips with a top border

changes.what: Headings group with what they introduce
changes.before: 24px between cards, 22px card padding above each heading

changes.what: Descriptions and help text wrap at a reading measure
Radii on one ladder
Hairlines thinned to half a pixel
changes.after: 0.5px dividers and edges; 1px only on control edges

changes.what: Stacking order from a named ladder

steps.summary: Shadows now belong only to things that float or block — the toast, the nav sheet, the dialog — each with one shadow recipe and an edge.

changes.what: Shadows on in-page things removed
changes.before: shadows on 5 cards, every input, every button and 3 logo tiles
changes.after: no shadow on anything that scrolls with the page

changes.what: Logos stand on their own instead of in shadowed tiles
Shadow recipes: one per level, each led by its edge
changes.before: 3 unrelated recipes, no edge on the toast
changes.after: 3 levels (raised, floating, overlay), each a 0.5px edge ring + contact + ambient

changes.what: Dark-mode dialog is lighter than the page under it
The delete dialog is the system's dialog: no one-off red icon circle
changes.before: 44px red icon circle above the title
changes.after: removed; red only on the Delete account button

changes.what: Scrim lighter and unblurred
Translucent surfaces
changes.before: 2 (blurred top bar, blurred scrim), no fallbacks

changes.what: The current nav row is a flat fill with a hairline edge, not a lifted pill

steps.summary: Every transition runs on one short ladder and one curve, exits are quicker than entrances, and reduced motion gets a real alternative instead of a kill switch.

changes.what: The dialog now closes with a short fade instead of vanishing
Dialog opening on the standard curve and the overlay tier
Colour changes on controls share one duration
The toast arrives in 150ms and leaves in 100ms, travelling half as far
Pressing a button changes its surface instead of nudging it down
changes.after: pressed surface step at 0ms, no travel

changes.what: Reduced motion swaps each animation for a substitute instead of zeroing everything
changes.before: global 0.01ms on every transition and animation
changes.after: dialog and toast fade in place, nav sheet fades, spinner stops

changes.what: Easing curves in use
changes.after: 1 standard curve, plus ease-out for colour and ease-in for exits

steps.summary: The words and behaviours now match what each action costs: saves report in place, a reversible disconnect offers Undo, and deleting the account says what is lost and waits until it's done.

changes.what: Saving no longer also pops a toast; the status line beside the button already says "Saved just now"
changes.law: patterns dial: toasts for failures, Undo and off-screen results

changes.what: Disconnecting an account offers Undo
The delete dialog says what will be lost
changes.before: "This permanently deletes Priya Anand and signs you out of every device."
changes.after: Lists profile, personal tasks and comments, sign-out everywhere, projects moving to an admin, and "This can't be undone."

changes.what: The phrase to type has a visible label
changes.before: visually hidden label, phrase in a placeholder
changes.after: visible label "Type delete my account to confirm"

changes.what: Deleting shows progress and holds the dialog open until it finishes
changes.before: dialog closes the instant you click
changes.after: "Deleting…", Cancel and Escape held off for the duration, focus back on the opener

changes.what: Error messages say what to do
changes.after: "Enter your email address." · "Fix the highlighted fields to change your password."

changes.what: Connect is a secondary button, leaving one primary action per section
changes.before: blue primary button among two Disconnects

changes.what: The ⌘K hint in search now works
